evidence_effect.note: the noise floor draws prompts one by one, not by article, which makes the limit a little strict

settings.ei_resampling: articles, sorted by PMCID as text

contamination: Known contamination: Qwen3's and Gemma 4's pretraining text is not published and may include PMC articles (EI's articles are PMC's), EI's repository (public since 2019), PubMedQA and the UCI data, which would favor both; EI's test labels are public (the project's site serves them to its leaderboard), so no evaluation of EI can be blind; Laya's, ModernBERT's and reader v1's notes and session 4's notes on Duan stand.
runs: Each EI seed ran once and the three are reported apart as well as averaged; s8_a3 and s7_a3 differ in the keep rule and in the run itself, so s8_a3 minus s7_a3 cannot separate the two; retraining alone moved PubMedQA log loss by about 0.023 per run in this project (results/fiorillo_v0_2/retry_check.json).
biodecision: BioDecision-4B's 70.6 was measured, by its model card, on the bigbio copy of EI, whose context is one evidence span and in which 73.4 percent of rows carry another prompt's span (the check of 30 September), so it is named and not compared. The published results counted the 6 test prompts of the empty article, which are left out here.

g3.note: BioDecision-4B's 70.6 was measured, by its model card, on the bigbio copy of EI, whose context is one evidence span and in which 73.4 percent of rows carry another prompt's span (the check of 30 September), so it is named and not compared. The published results counted the 6 test prompts of the empty article, which are left out here.

g4_load_check.note: s7_b3_timing's raw test probabilities against session 7's s7_b3-raw test file (correction 4). Session 7 predicted both questions together at batch size 16 and s7_b3_timing PubMedQA alone, so the padding differs; under bfloat16 a difference of about 1e-3 is padding, not a loading fault (derived)

g6.note: the hand-off's numbers are in handoff_test.json (handoff_session8.py), reported as they are

1.rule: s8_ei's ECE at most the limit (the larger of 0.05 and the 95th percentile of a calibrated model's ECE at n 1,218, fixed in release_candidate.json before any test prediction)

2.rule: s8_ei's log loss below the prior's, with the 95 percent interval of the difference (s8_ei minus the prior; 10,000 article resamples) wholly below zero

3.rule: s8_ei's log loss below gemma4_31b's (both calibrated on validation), with the 95 percent interval of the difference (10,000 article resamples) wholly below zero

4.rule: s8_ei's macro-F1 not below gemma4_31b's point estimate

release_bar.outcome: every criterion passes; releasing v0.4 is my decision after the closeout
